response.query: What safety governance, monitoring thresholds, explicit stopping conditions and human-override policies must be in place before any production deployment of models using triadic semiosis modules?
response.answer: Safety governance must include rigorous testing, monitoring thresholds for performance and error rates, explicit stopping conditions based on model performance, and human-override policies for immediate intervention.

results.content: For those applicants whose native language is not English, the University will accept the following forms of evidence: a) An undergraduate or graduate degree from an institution in which English is the language of instruction b) Test of English as a Foreign Language (TOEFL) with a minimum iBT total score of 90 c) Test of English for International Communication (TOEIC) with a minimum score of 785 d) Cambridge English Advanced (CAE) with a minimum score of 200 e) University of Michigan or Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English f) International English Language Testing System (IELTS) score of 6.5 or above g) Hellenic American University Advanced Level Certificate in English (C2) h) LANGUAGECERT Academic with a minimum score of 75 (for MAAL-TESOL and Doctoral studies a minimum score of 90) 19  2025-2026 University Catalog © Hellenic American University i) j) Other evidence of proficiency will be reviewed individually In the event that a language certificate from the aforementioned list was obtained several years ago, the University reserves the right to request a more recent proof of English language certificate or schedule an interview for the purpose of assessing the applicant's current English language competency and/or proficiency. Past positions have included Academic Director of General Education, Coordinator of Student Affairs for Hellenic American University (over six years); currently adjunct faculty member in undergraduate and graduate programs.
